statement: For set-valued presheaves F on I, invariance of global sections under u is equivalent to u_!1_{I\prime}\to1_I being invertible; at i this is \pi_0(i\backslash I\prime)\to1.

statement: A functor u:I\prime\to I is cofinal when every i\backslash I\prime is nonempty and connected, and co-cofinal when every I\prime/i is nonempty and connected.

statement: A subcategory is cofinal or co-cofinal when its inclusion has the corresponding property.

statement: A cofinal u induces a bijection \pi_0(I\prime)\to\pi_0(I).

statement: A cofinal u has the property F1: for every i there exist i\prime and an arrow i\to u(i\prime).

statement: F2 requires every pair \beta,\gamma:i\rightrightarrows u(i\prime) to be equalized by some u(\alpha\prime), with \alpha\prime:i\prime\to j\prime.

statement: If I\prime is nonempty and any two objects have a common successor, F1 and F2 imply u is cofinal and every i\backslash I\prime has the same weak directedness property.

statement: If I\prime is filtered, u is cofinal iff F1 and F2 hold iff all i\backslash I\prime are filtered; then I is filtered.

statement: u is M-connected (initially also called M-biaspherical) if restriction M^{I^{op}}\to M^{I\prime^{op}} is fully faithful.
